12:34.designContext:
Frame "Checkout" (1440×900, fill color/bg). Container max-width 960, padding 40×24, 2-column grid (2fr 1fr), gap 24.
- Title "Checkout" spanning both columns, Arial Bold 32px.
- Form card (fill color/surface, 1px color/border, radius/md, padding 24): labeled inputs Nome, E-mail (type email), Cartão — label bold, margin-bottom 8; input padding 12, 1px color/input-border, radius 8, margin-bottom 16; full-width primary button "Pagar R$ 49".
- Summary card (same card style): rows "Plano Pro — R$ 49" and "Total — R$ 49", label left and bold value right.
